content: Link unfurling is server-side for Slack, LinkedIn, X and Facebook: the platform's crawler fetches the shared page URL, parses OG meta tags, then a second fetcher (Slack-ImgProxy for Slack) separately fetches the og:image URL. WhatsApp reads static HTML and caches the preview per device. Practical consequence: any data encoded in a shared URL's query string is transmitted to and logged by every platform the link is pasted into, plus every recipient's messaging client that auto-previews. Users can disable previews (WhatsApp Settings > Privacy > Advanced) but the sender cannot.
